proof_body:
by
  intro α _ A B k j hd hjk
  rw [← Finset.card_powersetCard, ← Finset.card_powersetCard, ← Finset.card_product]
  refine Finset.card_nbij' (fun U => (U ∩ A, U ∩ B)) (fun p => p.1 ∪ p.2) ?_ ?_ ?_ ?_
  · intro U hU
    simp only [Finset.coe_filter, Set.mem_setOf_eq, Finset.mem_powersetCard] at hU
    obtain ⟨⟨hsub, hk⟩, hj⟩ := hU
    have hsplit : (U ∩ A).card + (U ∩ B).card = k := by
      rw [← hk, ← Finset.card_union_of_disjoint (Finset.disjoint_of_subset_left Finset.inter_subset_right (Finset.disjoint_of_subset_right Finset.inter_subset_right hd)), ← Finset.inter_union_distrib_left, Finset.inter_eq_left.mpr hsub]
    simp only [Finset.mem_coe, Finset.mem_product, Finset.mem_powersetCard]
    refine ⟨⟨Finset.inter_subset_right, hj⟩, Finset.inter_subset_right, ?_⟩
    omega
  · rintro ⟨X, Y⟩ hp
    simp only [Finset.mem_coe, Finset.mem_product, Finset.mem_powersetCard] at hp
    obtain ⟨⟨hX, hXc⟩, hY, hYc⟩ := hp
    have hXY : Disjoint X Y := Finset.disjoint_of_subset_left hX (Finset.disjoint_of_subset_right hY hd)
    have hYA : Y ∩ A = ∅ := by
      rw [← Finset.disjoint_iff_inter_eq_empty]
      exact (Finset.disjoint_of_subset_left hY hd.symm)
    simp only [Finset.coe_filter, Set.mem_setOf_eq, Finset.mem_powersetCard]
    refine ⟨⟨Finset.union_subset_union hX hY, ?_⟩, ?_⟩
    · rw [Finset.card_union_of_disjoint hXY, hXc, hYc]; omega
    · rw [Finset.union_inter_distrib_right, hYA, Finset.union_empty, Finset.inter_eq_left.mpr hX, hXc]
  · intro U hU
    simp only [Finset.coe_filter, Set.mem_setOf_eq, Finset.mem_powersetCard] at hU
    simp only
    rw [← Finset.inter_union_distrib_left, Finset.inter_eq_left.mpr hU.1.1]
  · rintro ⟨X, Y⟩ hp
    simp only [Finset.mem_coe, Finset.mem_product, Finset.mem_powersetCard] at hp
    obtain ⟨⟨hX, _⟩, hY, _⟩ := hp
    have hYA : Y ∩ A = ∅ := by
      rw [← Finset.disjoint_iff_inter_eq_empty]
      exact (Finset.disjoint_of_subset_left hY hd.symm)
    have hXB : X ∩ B = ∅ := by
      rw [← Finset.disjoint_iff_inter_eq_empty]
      exact (Finset.disjoint_of_subset_left hX hd)
    simp only [Prod.mk.injEq]
    constructor
    · rw [Finset.union_inter_distrib_right, hYA, Finset.union_empty, Finset.inter_eq_left.mpr hX]
    · rw [Finset.union_inter_distrib_right, hXB, Finset.empty_union, Finset.inter_eq_left.mpr hY]
target_source: ∀ (α : Type*) [DecidableEq α] (A B : Finset α) (k j : ℕ), Disjoint A B → j ≤ k → (((A ∪ B).powersetCard k).filter (fun U => (U ∩ A).card = j)).card = A.card.choose j * B.card.choose (k - j)
